scope: Confirmation latency and how it is earned, measured on the shipped recipe
why: the case asks whether the train sees an obstacle EARLY enough to react, and lists confirmation delay among the metrics worth reporting; the value had never been measured
reading: confirmation is effectively immediate at the 10 Hz stream rate: a candidate that is geometrically sound is confirmed on the scan it arrives (immediate_geometry), and one that is not needs a single further scan (median 1 frame, p90 2). There is no slow-confirmation defect to fix, and the value is recorded so that claim rests on a measurement rather than on reading the thresholds.
